files.content:
# Code Review Agent Template
# Reviews code for bugs, security issues, and style improvements.

version: "0.4.2"

persona:
  name: "Code Review Agent"
  description: "Reviews code for bugs, security vulnerabilities, performance issues, and style improvements."
  version: "0.1.0"
  authors: ["You"]
  tags: ["code-review", "developer-tools", "quality", "security"]

pricing:
  model: "free"  # Options: free, subscription, one_time.
  amount: 0      # Price in USD. Ignored when model is 'free'.
  # billing_period: "monthly" # Options: monthly, annual (for subscription)
  # trial:
  #   enabled: true
  #   days: 7

interface:
  input:
    type: "object"
    required: ["code"]
    properties:
      code:
        type: "string"
        title: "Code to Review"
        description: "Paste the code snippet or file you'd like reviewed."
language:
        type: "string"
        title: "Programming Language"
        description: "Leave blank to auto-detect."
        default: ""
      focus:
        type: "string"
        title: "Review Focus"
        enum: ["general", "security", "performance", "style"]
        default: "general"

  ui:
    code: { "ui:widget": "textarea" }

  output:
    type: "string"

runtime:
  adapter:
    type: "custom"
    entry_point: "src.main:agent"

  mode: "standard"
  lifecycle: "serverless"

policies:
  allow_internet_access: false
  max_steps: 15
  execution_timeout_seconds: 60

# Code Review Agent
# Receives code + focus area, returns a structured review.

def agent(inputs):
    code = inputs.get('code', '')
    language = inputs.get('language', 'auto-detect') or 'auto-detect'
    focus = inputs.get('focus', 'general')

    # TODO: call your preferred LLM here
    # Example (pseudo-code):
    # prompt = build_review_prompt(code, language, focus)
    # return llm.complete(prompt)

    return f'[Code Review — {focus}]\n\nLanguage: {language}\n\n{code[:80]}...\n\n(Implement your review logic above)'
